title: Resource manifests could read and publish files outside their directory

reproductions.test: packages/registry/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts > rejects a resource file path that escapes the resource directory
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: expected generateRegistryItem to throw, but it returned normally after packaging a sibling secret.tsx file.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: generation rejects the path before reading or serializing the file.

reproductions.test: packages/catalog/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts > rejects resource files that resolve through a symlink outside their directory
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: the expected outside-directory containment error was absent; the validator followed the link into the sibling directory.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: the canonical target is rejected before the import scanner reads it.

reproductions.test: packages/registry/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts > rejects resource files that resolve through a symlink outside their directory
reproductions.beforeFix: Not run before implementation; added to cover the shared filesystem boundary.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: the canonical target is rejected before content is added to the registry item.

reproductions.test: packages/schemas/src/__tests__/leaf-contracts.test.ts > rejects absolute and traversal paths in resource file contracts
reproductions.beforeFix: Not run before implementation; added as a schema contract regression.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed for POSIX traversal, nested traversal, POSIX absolute, Windows absolute, Windows traversal, and UNC paths.
